texts.name: Michael
texts.biography: A devout knight of Erathia, Michael found his path forever altered during a night of fervent prayer. When he believed the battle was lost, the sheer purity and power of his heartfelt prayer pierced the heavens. In that darkest hour, the divine Archangel Michael appeared before him, bestowing holy guidance and resurrecting his fallen troops, completely turning the fate of the battle. Ever since, Michael rides into battle blessed with celestial protection, fiercely guarded by the archangels standing steadfast at his back.

specialty.name: Angels
specialty.description: Increases the speed of any Angels or Archangels by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).

texts.name: Charles
texts.biography: For many years, Sir Charles had trained Paladins in Steadwick, but gave up being a tutor and started his career as a Dragon Hunter in Jadame. However, when the war had come, he came back to Erathia and began fighting for Morgan Kendal as a commander.

specialty.name: Templars
specialty.description: Increases the speed of any Templars or Paladins by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
